sources.quote: $0.14 / million input tokens (cache hit) 💰 $0.55 / million input tokens (cache miss) 💰 $2.19 / million output tokens
sources.supports: DeepSeek's January 20, 2025 R1 release specified the same cache-hit, cache-miss, and output prices recorded before the models.dev schema change.

notes: The earlier models.dev record omitted the cache-hit price even though DeepSeek's R1 release listed it as $0.14 per million input tokens; the $0.55 input and $2.19 output rates were also official. The Wayback CDX endpoint listed a June 9, 2025 pricing-page snapshot, but fetching the snapshot from web.archive.org failed, so no precise change date or archived table quote is asserted.
